'''''The Last Jedi''''' is a novel by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]] that was released on [[February 26]], [[2013]].<ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/SDCC_Del_Rey_Announces_New_Titles_146930.asp|text=SDCC: Del Rey Announces New Titles|work=TheForce.net|date=2012-07-13|archivedate=20241213075951}}</ref> The book's original name was ''Jedi Dawn'', but on [[March 2]], [[2011]], Bohnhoff confirmed that the title had changed, saying, "I noted that Jedi Dawn has already been used for [[Jedi Dawn|another book]] and Michael really likes the title Last Jedi."<ref>{{WordPress|subdomain=knightsarchive|url=2011/03/02/galactic-news-minute-5|text=Galactic News Minute (2.28-3.6)|name=Knights Archive|nolive=1}}</ref>
